<svg:title>Trace a Double-Recombinant Chromatid</svg:title>
<svg:desc>Schematic of two participating nonsister chromatids. Original allele rows in D-C-H order are +c+ and d+h. The highlighted path starts on the first chromatid at D, switches to the second at C, and returns to the first at H. The product is +++, with parental outer +/+ alleles and the exchanged middle allele. The faint reciprocal path produces dch. Red identifies the CD interval and blue the CH interval.</svg:desc>
